overview: 1933 report: mail for Washington legations arrived unpaid; only official mail should bypass postage in diplomatic pouches.

subfiles.title: List-of-papers entry on unpaid Japanese postage
subfiles.from: U.S. mission in Japan (despatch or telegram no. 315)
subfiles.about: An index entry records a communication requesting investigation of mail sent to certain Washington legations without payment of Japanese postage.
subfiles.summary: 1933 entry: mail for Washington legations arrived without postage; only official correspondence should travel unpaid in diplomatic pouches, requesting investigation.

interest: Tracks a 1933 complaint over unpaid Japanese diplomatic postage.
